summary: Iter96 — Global Theme Unification (dark default + one-click light/dark toggle) FULLY VALIDATED across Landing, Client V2 (mobile), Specialist (desktop), Admin (desktop), /preturi, /preturi/zugravit, /admin/control-tower. All 8 test criteria PASS. Zero non-401 console errors. Theme toggle syncs 3 attributes (data-theme, data-admin-theme, Tailwind 'dark' class) + persists via localStorage propmanage_theme. Global theme is single source of truth across all roles. Details: (1) LANDING — theme-switcher visible in nav; DEFAULT dark (bg rgb(10,10,11), data-theme=None+dark class); toggle → LIGHT (bg rgb(250,250,249), data-theme=light, admin-theme=light); CTA 'Începe gratuit · 14 zile' bg=rgb(212,255,58) lime, color=rgb(28,25,23) near-black ✓; toggle back OK; reload persistence OK (ls=light → data-theme=light). (2) CLIENT (mobile 390x844, login via /login page which is real auth route, /auth is a demo modal) — DASHBOARD DARK: bg=rgb(10,10,11) near-black, 'Vezi cererea' bg=rgb(212,255,58) color=rgb(0,0,0), FAB 'Solicită' lime+black+, near-black+lime accents ✓. LIGHT toggle: bg=rgb(250,250,249), .cv2-scope bg=rgb(250,251,250), 'Vezi cererea' still lime+black ✓; cv2-scope override correctly gated by html:not([data-theme=light]) — light theme lifts dark overrides. All 4 tabs (Acasă/Lucrări/Propr./Setări) render light body+cards+dark readable text ✓. ZERO instances of legacy emerald #34C759 (rgb(52,199,89)) detected across whole DOM in light theme. (3) CLIENT REQUEST WIZARD — opens via central FAB in both themes; step 1 category cards (Zugrăvit/Parchet/Faianță/Handyman/Gips-carton/HVAC/Electric/Sanitar/Design Interior) all readable, progress bar lime; wizard bg matches theme (dark in dark, light in light) ✓. (4) SPECIALIST (desktop 1440x800) — DARK default renders classic dark+lime ✓; LIGHT: bg=rgb(250,250,249), 'Astăzi ai:' KPI cards render LIGHT (white cards + dark text) after removal of forced dark wrapper — VERIFIED ✓. (5) ADMIN (desktop) — /admin DARK: data-theme=None, admin-theme=dark, dark-class=True, bg=rgb(10,10,11) ✓; toggle → data-theme=light, admin-theme=light, dark-class=False, bg=rgb(250,250,249). Cross-page persistence: /admin light → navigate to / (still light) → back to /admin (still light) ✓ SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH confirmed. AI Insights + KPI cards + Briefing rapid all correctly styled in both themes ✓. (6) /preturi + /preturi/zugravit — theme-switcher present in header on both, works (light bg white/dark bg black), tables/breadcrumb readable ✓. (7) COLOR UNIFICATION — NO #34C759 anywhere in client light theme; hero card 'Lucrare activă' gradient shows lime background w/ black-on-lime 'Vezi cererea' CTA ✓. (8) REGRESSION — /admin/control-tower renders in both themes with data-testid=control-tower-page present; specialist bottom nav (Oportunități/Lucrările mele/Notificări/Setări) works; client bottom nav (Acasă/Lucrări/Solicită/Propr./Setări) works; /login renders; ZERO non-401 console errors across all tested pages (401s are backend auth calls, expected on public/protected transitions).

Minor: 'SCHIMBĂ LA CLIENT' toggle chip in specialist topbar uses lime text on rgba(212,255,58,0.1) fill — near invisible fill contrast on both themes; consider stronger outline in light theme.

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.jsx L14 — accepts legacy 'warm-linen' → 'light' fallback. Once no clients store 'warm-linen' (check localStorage migration complete after N days), remove this branch to simplify normalize().

ThemeContext.jsx L27-28 — writes BOTH localStorage keys (propmanage_theme + pm_admin_theme) on every state change. If pm_admin_theme is now vestigial (admin reads global useTheme via delegation per AdminLayoutMetronic), consider removing pm_admin_theme write to avoid drift risk and simplify migration story.

index.css L754-764 (.cv2-scope dark overrides) — uses !important cascades gated by `html:not([data-theme="light"])`. This works but if a future page adds a third theme (e.g., 'sepia'), those styles will INCORRECTLY apply. Change gate to `html[data-theme="dark"], html:not([data-theme])` (explicit) OR set data-theme='dark' explicitly in dark mode instead of removing it (currently useEffect L23 does `removeAttribute` for dark). Explicit is safer.
ThemeSwitcher.jsx — only exports named ThemeSwitcher; no default export. Any imports using `import ThemeSwitcher from ...` will break. Not observed in this test but flag for consistency.
Positive: Single ThemeProvider + one useEffect handles all 3 attributes + localStorage. Clean. No race conditions observed across route changes and reloads.

Positive: Admin's `useAdminTheme` delegation to global `useTheme` (AdminLayoutMetronic L~13) resolves the split-brain issue from iter93/94 — single source of truth confirmed by nav test (/admin light → / preserves light → /admin still light).
